- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT generated £10.7k revenue in TW, representing 19.3% of total product revenue of £55.6k, with 5,593 units sold across 43 orders.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT revenue surged 18,473.8% WoW, the strongest growth among all products in TW.
- ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE RED achieved £2.4k revenue in TW with a 4.4% share, making it the second-largest revenue contributor.
- CHILLI LIGHTS and PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS each generated over £2.2k revenue in TW, capturing 4.1% and market share respectively.
- WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS led unit sales with 5,328 units in TW, second only to RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT's 5,593 units.
- ALARM CLOCK BAKELIKE PINK showed exceptional YoY growth of 611.7% in TW compared to LY.
- WORLD WAR 2 GLIDERS ASSTD DESIGNS revenue increased 513.2% YoY in TW, demonstrating strong year-on-year momentum.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS received the most orders in TW with 64 orders, followed by JUMBO BAG PAISLEY PARK with 46 orders.
